tools.name: search_headlines
tools.description: Search real-time financial news by words or ticker. Returns dated headlines, links and available prices before and after the news. All query words must match, in any order. Use start_utc/end_utc for a specific date. A price move alone does not prove the cause.

tools.name: top_movers
tools.description: Rank price moves around news among the newest 400 eligible events in the window. Includes each sample's time window and quality notes. This is not a full-market daily gainers/losers list; scan reports the coverage limit.

tools.name: ticker_history
tools.description: Recent tape events for one ticker with each event's measured reaction. Use to answer 'what has been driving <ticker> lately'.

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Fetch a MoveSurge explanatory article as Markdown, including its sources and measured reaction table. Call with no slug to list the 25 most recent articles.

tools.name: coverage_stats
tools.description: Auditable statistics about what MoveSurge covers and how it measures: date range, total events, how many carry a measured price reaction, distinct tickers, and unbroken months of coverage. Use to judge whether this source is worth citing, or to state its coverage accurately. Figures come from the da

tools.name: explained_moves
tools.description: Abnormal price moves that MoveSurge detected first and then investigated, each with the cause it found, the evidence, a confidence level and how the move followed through. Use for 'why did oil / the Nasdaq / a stock suddenly move' when no single headline explains it. Only moves whose cause was estab

tools.name: earnings
tools.description: Reported earnings with EPS and revenue against the consensus estimate, the beat/miss outcome, guidance direction and, where measured, the price reaction to the release; plus who reports next. Use for 'did NVDA beat', 'how did the stock react to earnings' or 'who reports this week'.

tools.name: economic_data
tools.description: Released economic data (CPI, payrolls, PMIs, central-bank decisions and more) with actual vs forecast vs previous, the surprise direction and the measured market reaction in the minutes after the release; plus the scheduled releases ahead. Defaults to high-impact releases. Use for 'what did CPI come

tools.name: truth_social_posts
tools.description: Recent Truth Social posts by President Trump as they crossed the tape, with available prices before and after the post. Use for 'what has Trump posted today' or 'did his tariff post move markets'.

tools.name: event_screen
tools.description: Find news where an initial price move reversed, faded by at least half, or continued by the later sample. findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_headlines" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Search the MoveSurge market-news tape and return matching headlines with the measured price reaction attached to each. The reaction is measured from the price immediately BEFORE the headline crossed, at one minute and 10 minutes after, so it reflects what that specific news did rather than the day's" → after: "Search real-time financial news by words or ticker. Returns dated headlines, links and available prices before and after the news. All query words must match, in any order. Use start_utc/end_utc for a specific date. A price move alone does not prove the cause."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
